model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the inference time measured for the baseline Llama models, as well as the 1B and 3B scale models, at a batch size of x=6.1. The x-axis is labeled “Batch size” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 300, with tick labels at intervals of 16. The y-axis is labeled “Inference time (seconds)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 2. There are five lines shown. The Llama-1B line is colored blue, uses circle markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 9.6 seconds at a batch size of 1 and decreases to approximately 3.7 seconds at a batch size of 300. The Llama-3B line is colored orange, uses square markers, and uses a dashed line style; it begins at approximately 9.4 seconds at a batch size of 1 and decreases to approximately 3.3 seconds at a batch size of 300. The MambaLlama-1B line is colored green, uses diamond markers, and is solid; it starts at approximately 8.8 seconds at a batch size of 1 and decreases to approximately 2.6 seconds at a batch size of 300. The MambaLlama-3B line is colored red, uses triangle markers, and is dashed; it starts at approximately 8.6 seconds at a batch size of 1 and decreases to approximately 2.3 seconds at a batch size of 300. Finally, the MambalLlama line is colored purple, has no markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 9.2 seconds at a batch size of 1 and decreases to approximately 2.8 seconds at a batch size of 300.
